- The standards-pack adoption item went blocked in BACKLOG.md (2026-08-12):

- Asset drop-ins are wired but need manual, licensed downloads: fonts
  `resources/fonts/monogram.ttf` + `m6x11.ttf` (theme.lua picks them up
  automatically; m6x11 requires attribution), sound files per
  `resources/sounds/README.md` (audio.lua synthesizes fallbacks today), and
  Caz's 32px keycap pack (CC BY 4.0). Each requires a human to fetch from
  itch.io, verify the license, and update `CREDITS.txt` — asset acquisition
  is out of scope for automations.
- `docs/STEAM_CHECKLIST.md` is a manual, account-and-payment-gated track
